objective: Transport actual routed DAG refutations with acyclic fresh declarations t=fg over two old affine forms into the same extension calculus, with explicit costs counting declarations.
status: Proved: A signed-literal and constant map that projects the pinned input axioms transports syntactic degree-two proofs with ordered fresh affine product declarations into the same named system. The construction retains the declarations and their dependencies, with at most twice the original number of nodes on strict source clauses.
title: Proof transport with fresh product names
